overview_description.description:
In Ivvest we use science and technology to develop the most cost-efficient, scalable and easy to operate indoor farming solutions for MENA!
 
As a start-up we are always motivated by our passion to solve new challenges, develop new solutions and products and keep on learning with vision to becoming key players in the Controlled-Environment Agriculture (CEA) industry within the MENA region.

about_short_description.short_description: Ivvest delivers sustainable farming technology, vertical agriculture, and innovative plant protection.

product.name: The Capsule
product.description: A modular and smart container farming unit designed for indoor farming, capable of growing crops vertically.

product.name: IvvestOS
product.description: Software designed to optimize the performance of The Capsule, providing guidance and transparency in farm operations.

product.name: Join a Cluster
product.description: An investment opportunity allowing individuals to start with one or more Capsules, requiring a cluster of 5 units to begin operations.

product.name: Installing the Capsule
product.description: A service that includes the installation of The Capsules at a designated location after manufacturing.

product.name: Start Producing
product.description: A service providing seeds, fertilizers, and expert supervision for Capsule operations, offered at a monthly cost.

product.name: Collect Profits
product.description: A financial arrangement where Ivvest transacts profits to investors, deducting an operational profit share.
